title: CAST APPLICATION
knowledge: States the nurse's responsibilities with regards to application of cast.
Verbalizes the potential complications for patient with cast.
Verbalizes the educational needs of the patient with cast.
skills: Demonstrates the preparation of equipment, correct procedure for application and removal of cast.
Demonstrates holistic assessment and care of the patient with cast.
Demonstrates related assessment, interventions and care of the patient with cast.
attitude: Maintains patient's privacy and confidentiality before and after the procedure.
Answers patient and family questions politely.

title: CAST CARE APPLICATION AND REMOVAL
knowledge: States the nurse's responsibility in regard to care, application and removal of cast.
Verbalizes the potential complications for patient with a cast.
Verbalizes the educational needs of a patient with a cast.
skills: Provides age specific patient teaching culturally sensitive patient teaching.
Demonstrates procedures for application/adaptation and removal of casts.
Demonstrates holistic assessment and care of the patient with a cast.
Documents related assessment, interventions and care of patient with a cast.
Facilitate the application of the cast for the safety of the pt. and health care providers.
attitude: Provides introduction of self and explain the procedure appropriately and privately
Respect patient's response to care and provide answer to patient's inquiries pertaining to cast

title: CONTINUOUS MONITORING
knowledge: States the nursing responsibilities associated with initiation of continuous bedside monitoring.
Verbalizes rationale for initiating continuous bedside monitoring.
Verbalizes and identifies 5 life threatening cardiac arrhythmias in paediatrics.
States the normal values of heart rate, respiratory rate and blood pressure in age specific during sleeping and awake mode.
skills: Utilizes assessment skills to identify those children who require continuos bedside monitoring.
Demonstrates correct connection of all sensors and leads from the monitor to the child.
Demonstrates recognition of bradycardia, SVT, VT,VF, Asystole and PEA.
Utilizes culturally sensitive age specific child/ family teaching.
Responds immediately to any alarms from the monitoring system.
Demonstrates use of monitor and its available functions.
Demonstrates appropriate alarm settings for individual child.
Documents related assessment, interventions and care on patient record.
attitude: Shows vigilance in performing continuous monitoring of critically ill paediatric patients.
